scope: Local Cambridge poster and supporting project writing. Do not apply these preferences to other projects.

writing.opening: Begin with wider Earth system model development needs, then introduce portable Fortran and compiler generation. Define unfamiliar terms, symbols and units.
writing.mathematics: GitHub dollar-and-backtick inline expressions and fenced math blocks. Keep one prose paragraph or list item on each source line.
writing.title_casing: Title case for the poster title and section headings
writing.punctuation: Avoid semicolons and colons in authored prose
punctuation_exceptions: Required literal syntax, quotations, official names and bibliography metadata
writing.changed_prose_colour_scope: Poster text only. Paper review colours follow their separate instructions.

poster.performance: The model sections are 3.2 Shallow-Water Model and 3.3 Energy-Balance Model. Each plot has CPU at the left and GPU at the right, with five left labels and eight route subrows. Purple circles, teal squares and navy diamonds identify the three grids. Tuned markers are solid and vanilla markers have coloured diagonal hatching on white faces. Faint rules separate groups and ESM.md is pale grey and bold. Both CPU and GPU rates use explicitly labelled logarithmic axes with positive margins and plain numeric ticks. The SW CPU header records 248 cores, while the EBM CPU header records ≤248 cores and the shared notes state its 128-band cap. The GPU header records one GH200. All displayed points and ranges come unchanged from the accepted fresh input.
poster.figure_unit_labels: Put units in square brackets on axes, colour bars and variable-label declarations. Keep plotted values, scales and ordinary value-unit expressions unchanged.

skills.md2fort: Generation, verification and optimisation guidance for portable Fortran CPU solvers
skills.md2fort-gpu: GPU generation, verification and optimisation guidance covering CUDA Fortran and direct PTX comparisons

poster.performance_measurement_status: Publication requires the accepted 96-condition cohort, 1,152 elapsed times, two bound poster render receipts and the independent encoding receipt.
poster.reference_wording: Use the supplied original poster wording for Motivation, Methods and Summary where it remains accurate. Update solver routes to Fortran and CUDA Fortran and name both md2fort skills. Keep fresh performance outcomes pending until accepted measurements exist.
poster.physical_illustration_scope: The SW illustration is a separate periodic dam-break test. Its data and frame are unchanged.

evidence.scope: Both performance figures, native notes and Summary use one complete accepted fresh eight-route cohort and its independent encoding receipt. The physical illustrations retain their separate figure-evidence.json inputs.
evidence.generation: Source identities and compiler versions follow the accepted records. Methods describe supplied Markdown, a frozen numerical contract, prior verified source, LLM candidates, human review and separate verification gates.

delivery: Inspect the actual final PDF and close-ups. Decode its QR at multiple render sizes. Display a PDF-rendered image in chat when requested.
